# Coleridge Meat

Official website: https://www.coleridgemeat.co.za/
Business type: Halaal butcher and meat supplier
Location: 18 Tennant Rd, Cloetesville, Stellenbosch, Western Cape, South Africa
Phone: +27 61 127 5756
Email: info@coleridgemeat.co.za

Coleridge Meat is a Stellenbosch butcher with one public online catalogue.
The business offers premium beef, lamb, chicken, braai cuts, boerewors, family favourites, and spitbraai catering.
Orders can be placed online and confirmed directly by the team.
The catalogue includes family favourites, larger pack formats, and made-to-order lines.

Opening hours:
- Monday to Friday: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM
- Saturday: 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM
- Sunday and public holidays: Closed
